effect_description_eng: [On Play] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less. Then, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon doesn't unsuspend.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
